(16) 「培訓實務課程」係指募心募款及親身參與四大志業、八大法印。
為兼顧家業、事業、志業圓滿與慧命成長，「培訓實務課程」可由培訓委員慈誠自選，於一年或二年內完成。實務課程參與方式勾選：□一年內完成□二年內完成
Practical Training includes fundraising and personally taking part in Tzu Chi’s Four Missions and Eight Dharma Footprints.
To balance family, work and carrying out Tzu Chi’s Missions as well as cultivating our wisdom-life, certification training can be completed in one or two years.
Please select your preference: □ 1 year □ 2 years
